messages:
sam: quick q in my first week — I'm wiring up monitor-service and need two secrets for dev: a read-only DB credential and our Sentry DSN. What's the fastest approved route to get these without blocking local testing? cc @kim

kim (DevEx): welcome! :wave: fast path: 1) request membership in `vault-users` on GitHub if you haven't already; 2) submit the secrets-request form (select 'new-service' and tag 'onboarding') https://go.redwood.internal/forms/secrets-request; 3) for DB creds choose "ephemeral DB role" in the form (we prefer ephemeral over long-lived). For Sentry DSN we can give a vault KV path.

Quick test commands once access is granted:
```bash
vault login -method=oidc
vault kv get secret/data/services/monitor-service
# ephemeral DB creds (if configured):
vault read database/creds/monitor-role
```
(Do not paste secrets in Slack)

devex-bot: Sam, your onboarding task "Request Vault access" was created and assigned to kim (DevEx). :white_check_mark:

infra-ops: Note: for DB we use the DB secrets engine; you will get credentials with a lease (default 1h) instead of a static password. If you actually need a KMS key (rare for dev), include: env, key-purpose, intended consumers, and rotation window in the form. Example ticket payload: `env:dev, service:monitor-service, key-purpose:signing, rotation_days:30, owner:sam@redwood.com`.

louise (Security): Rotation basics: ephemeral DB creds are preferred — they auto-rotate via leases. Service tokens or DSNs are stored in KV and should be rotated on a cadence you specify; recommended rotation for third-party DSNs is 30-90 days depending on sensitivity. Any request for prod long-lived keys requires security review and documented justification.

sam: thanks — who is the approver chain for prod secrets? my manager + security + infra?

kim (DevEx): yep: requester -> team lead -> infra (for provisioning) -> security (if prod or long-lived). Timeline: dev/staging ~same day, prod may take 1-3 business days. If this blocks a demo, put "expedite" on the form and ping @infra-ops.

sam: great, filing the form now. also link to any short lifecycle doc?

kim (DevEx): short read: https://go.redwood.internal/docs/secrets-lifecycle — covers leases, rotation windows, and exception process.

sam: perfect, thanks everyone!
